extensions.description: Paid data is settled over x402 (HTTP 402). The A2A endpoint itself is free.

description: Machine-payable US recall lookups over x402. Is this product or vehicle under an ACTIVE recall, and how urgent? Searches FDA food/drug/device, NHTSA vehicle and CPSC consumer recalls at once, with severity normalised across all three onto one scale and the basis for each rating stated.
name: RecallScout

skills.description: Given a product, brand, ingredient or vehicle, returns active US recalls across the FDA, NHTSA and CPSC with a normalised severity, the hazard, the remedy, and the lot codes needed to tell whether a specific unit is affected.
examples: any recalls on a 2020 Honda Accord
check if there is an active recall for a 2021 Ford F-150
has peanut butter been recalled recently
skills.name: is this product or vehicle recalled

skills.description: NHTSA recalls for a vehicle by make, model and year, including the do-not-drive and park-outside advisories that change what the owner should do today.
examples: any recalls on a 2020 Honda Accord
check if there is an active recall for a 2021 Ford F-150
skills.name: is this vehicle under an active recall

skills.description: Three regulators publish on three different scales. This maps FDA Class I-III, NHTSA and CPSC severities onto one comparable urgency, and states the basis for each rating rather than asserting a number.
examples: how serious is the infant formula recall
is this a Class I recall
skills.name: how urgent is this recall, across three agencies
